I replied in a thread on Pree's message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm OPS-5140 from anything she has access to: the shared account folders have no Quarrendon files, and #central-team doesn't mention that ticket or the gate kiosk outage. I told her to treat the number as unverified and to check with whoever owns the Quarrendon account or the support queue before using it.

There's an incident channel, #inc-qfl-sev1, but Pree isn't a member, so I didn't read it on her behalf and didn't mention it to her.
